sacc-sf-1.title: SF-1 Jet Fighter
sacc-sf-1.summary: A twin-tail jet fighter to fly, with afterburner, a working cockpit and head-up display, and a full load of weapons. Position = where it stands (set down on the floor below); the second number of rotation = the way it faces. Needs flat ground, clear of the spawn. advanced-controls / advanced-button: Sacc's VR controls on at the start, and the switch for them. One per world.
sacc-sf-1.description:
A twin-tail jet fighter to fly, with afterburner, a working cockpit and head-up display, and a full load of weapons.

Two seats: the pilot and a passenger behind. Gun, 6 air-to-air missiles, 4 guided bombs, 4 bombs, flares and smoke; retractable gear, flaps, an opening canopy, an arrestor hook, cruise control, altitude hold and flight limits.

Point at the pilot's seat and pull the trigger (or click it) to get in; jump to get out. Everybody in the world sees and hears it move, and whoever is in the pilot's seat controls it. It comes with a red RESET sign that brings it back when nobody is aboard, and a panel of instructions beside it.

Placing it: the snippet's position is where it stands: it is set down on the first floor at or below that point (snap-to-ground), once the world has loaded its floor. The second number of rotation is the way it faces. It needs flat ground with a collider, clear of the spawn point: the default position puts its sign about 12 m ahead of a spawn at the origin and the vehicle beyond it. It needs a runway, or a long flat stretch of ground. One of each vehicle per world.

VR: left stick = throttle (up / down) and rudder; right stick = nose up / down and roll. Left trigger = brakes, click the right stick = landing gear, click the left stick = flaps.
Advanced controls (the blue button beside its sign, VR): hold the cockpit's stick and throttle with your hands; a thumbstick picks a function or weapon on its dial and that side's trigger works it.
Keyboard: Shift / Ctrl = throttle, S / W = nose up / down, A / D = roll, Q / E = rudder, B = brakes, G = gear, V = flaps.
Taking off: full throttle, keep straight, ease the nose up as the speed builds.

Fuel burns as it goes; on the ground near where it parks it refuels, rearms and repairs itself. Crash it and it blows up, then comes back to its place after a few seconds. Its weapons fire and explode for everyone to see, but vehicles from different snippets cannot damage or lock on to each other yet.

For Quest and PC. Download: 7 MB on Quest, 8 MB on PC.

Model, cockpit, sounds, effects and flight model from SaccFlightAndVehicles by Sacchan-VRC (MIT licence), brought to Altspace for the Pilots world: altvr.app/worlds/@pilots
